test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 6.
solution:
The correct answer is 'people.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, we are referring to human beings in general or considered collectively.
 
 
• इस वाक्य में हम सामान्य रूप से या सामूहिक रूप से माने जाने वाले मनुष्य की बात कर रहे हैं।
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'people.'
 
• *​​*Correct phrase__: **........ **what could be done to get such **people **out of institutions and onto the streets, getting jobs, .......*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 
• **People** is used when referring to a collective group or indeterminate number, and** persons** serves better when referring to individuals (or a number of individuals).

 
 
• **Example**: *I saw three **people** standing on the corner.

 Any person or** persons **found in possession of illegal substances will be prosecuted.*
